name: Venom Chaos Boxes
description: A collection of complete synths based on chaos derived from simple circuits and feedback
author: David Benham

modules.name: Chaos Gates Expander
modules.description: Adds additional shift register gate outputs to Chaos Box modules. Included with any Chaos Boxes purchase

modules.name: Chaos Volts Expander
modules.description: Adds additional shift register CV outputs to Chaos Box modules. Included with any Chaos Boxes purchase

modules.name: Hybrid Knot
modules.description: Digitial emulation of the Lorre Mill Double Knot synthesizer incorporating elements of both versions 2 and 3

modules.name: Venjolin
modules.description: Digitial emulation of the After Later Audio Benjolin V2 plus enhancements

modules.name: Venjolin +
modules.description: Digitial emulation of the After Later Audio Benjolin V2 plus twin peaks resonator and other enhancements. Included with purchase of Venjolin

modules.name: Vlippoo Box
modules.description: Digitial emulation of Rob Hordijk's Blippoo Box 2018 version

modules.name: Vlippoo Box +
modules.description: Digitial emulation of Rob Hordijk's Blippoo Box with additional controls, inputs, and outputs. Included with purchase of Vlippoo Box
